title: 20 Small Businesses That Will Still Exist in 2040
description:
Robots, AI and apps are changing everything, but these 20 small businesses will almost certainly still exist in 2040. Here's why they last, how they make money and how to get in.

Get The Ryan Rover Money Playbook: [LINK HERE]

1:39 How we got the numbers

13:44 12. Pest control

20:21 19. Moving companies

22:10 Five businesses that may look very different by 2040
23:37 Two owners, twenty years
24:21 Six mistakes that kill durable businesses
25:34 Angle 1: The numbers
27:09 Inside a durable business: an example
28:35 Angle 2: The psychology
30:29 Angle 3: The playbook
33:05 Questions people ask
35:04 Recap
36:27 What to do next

Sources:
- Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Outlook Handbook (employment projections for trades and services)
- U.S. Census Bureau, population projections (growth of the 65 and older population)
- S&P Global Mobility, average age of light vehicles in the U.S. (over 12 years)
- U.S. Small Business Administration, 7(a) loan program (business acquisition loans)
- Durability comparison: simplified illustration ($100,000 a year for 20 years vs $200,000 a year for 3 years)
